explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain why the objective drops from 1190.57 to 670.57 even though the positive production variables `x_A1_I`, `x_A2_I`, `x_A2_II`, `x_A2_III`, `x_B1_II`, `x_B2_I`, `x_B2_III`, and `x_B3_I` remain numerically unchanged from the original solution. Your answer must trace the exact code additions `y[e]` and `joint_calibration` back to the CSV fields `Fixed_Setup_Cost`, `Effective_Machine_Hours`, and `A2_B2_joint_calibration_fee`, name the specific business brief terms they implement, and quantify the full 519.84 objective change using exact parameter values. Then use the LP-relaxation diagnostics to identify which of `capacity_B1` and `activation_B1` is carrying the marginal value, interpret the shadow price/slack economically, and explain why that dual-based linear extrapolation is not valid for asking “what if B1 were not activated” in the integer revised model.
